# Browser deployment matrix

This matrix is generated from the pinned Playwright 1.62.1 headless Linux qualification run over the single shipped simd128 AudioWorklet artifact. The version shown is the lowest version qualified by this run; older versions are unqualified, not implicitly supported.

| Browser engine | Qualified version floor | Attestation outcome | SIMD gate | AudioWorklet boot | Native corpus digest | 100 ms main-thread stall |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chromium | 151.0.7922.34 | simd128 supported | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| firefox | 153.0 | simd128 supported | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| webkit | 26.5 | simd128 supported | pass | pass | pass | pass |

The stall gate injects at least 100 ms of main-realm blocking after prefilling the 5120-frame default source ring. It requires bit-exact, dropout-free, frame-aligned output. `miso.unsupported.v1` is the only qualified refusal for a browser without simd128.

Playwright's browser builds are qualification targets, not claims about branded Chrome, Safari, or untested Firefox builds. Re-run the matrix before lowering a deployment floor or changing Playwright. This work does not qualify cross-origin isolation or shared-memory operation.
